document.about: HPE hard disk drives QuickSpecs. Its drive pages set a green band (Mission Critical (10K rpm), Business Critical (7.2K rpm)) over each block of fields and SKU tables.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#109): a title band or caption in a table's first row was taken as its column header, naming every column, and the rows that do name the columns read as data.

2026-11-24 (#109): with the band read out as a title, the field block's first field (Form Factor | SFF (2.5”) | Carrier | …) was presumed the header and named the fields under it. A row under a title must be set apart from the rows below to head them.

checks.issue: All 73 cells on page 10 carried the band as their column header.
Form Factor | SFF (2.5”), the first field under the band, was the column header of every field below it on pages 9 to 18. (Form Factor itself is a real column name in the SKU tables on pages 4 to 6.)
